ko.title: 새 규정 하의 학자금 대출: 상환 제도 변경과 신용점수 하락이 대출자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: 연방 학자금 대출 상환 제도는 1년 이상 변동을 겪고 있습니다.

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: 기존 플랜은 종료되는 중이고 새로운 플랜이 이를 대체하고 있으며, 상환이 지연된 많은 대출자들이 신용 보고서에서 손상을 확인하고 있습니다.

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: 연방 학자금 대출을 보유하고 있다면, 연말 마감일과 청구 주기로 인해 문제가 더 커지기 전에 지금 본인의 상태를 점검하기에 좋은 시기입니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *본 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적이며 재정적 또는 법적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Program details change, so confirm current rules at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: 프로그램 세부 사항은 변경될 수 있으므로 StudentAid.gov 또는 대출 서비스 기관에서 최신 규정을 확인하세요.*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## 왜 이렇게 많은 신용 보고서가 변경되고 있는가

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: 최근 발생한 문제의 대부분은 두 가지 주요 변화로 설명됩니다.

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: 신용평가사 연체 보고 재개.** 팬데믹 기간의 상환 유예 동안에는 연방 대출 연체 건이 보고되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: 2023년 말에 상환이 재개되었고, 1년 동안의 "온램프(on-ramp)" 유예 기간을 통해 대출자들의 연체 보고를 보호했습니다.

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: 해당 보호 조치가 종료되면서 미납 내역이 다시 신용 보고서에 나타나기 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: 뉴욕 연방준비은행의 연방 데이터와 연구에 따르면 수많은 대출자의 점수가 하락했으며, 일부는 큰 폭의 하락을 겪었습니다.

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: 채권 추심 활동 재개.** 정부는 2025년에 채무 불이행(채무불이행) 상태인 연방 대출에 대한 추심을 재개했습니다.

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: 발생 가능한 불이익에는 세금 환급금 및 기타 연방 지급금의 재무부 상계, 행정적 급여 압류 등이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: 대출은 일반적으로 미납 다음 날부터 연체 상태가 되며, 90일 후 신용평가사에 연체로 보고되고, 대부분의 연방 대출은 약 270일 후에 채무 불이행에 도달합니다.

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: 상환 이력은 일반적인 신용 평가 모델에서 가장 큰 단일 요소입니다.

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: 보고된 90일 연체는 특히 이전에 연체 기록이 없던 사람의 점수를 크게 낮출 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## 상환 방식에서 무엇이 바뀌고 있는가

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: 2025년에 통과된 연방 법안과 기존 플랜에 대한 진행 중인 소송으로 인해 상환 옵션이 재편되었습니다.

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: 알아두어야 할 주요 사항:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **SAVE 플랜이 종료됩니다.** 법원 판결로 인해 대출자들은 장기 상환 유예 상태에 남겨졌으며, 해당 프로그램은 단계적으로 폐지되고 있습니다. 등록되어 있던 대출자들은 다른 플랜으로 이전해야 합니다. 이전된 후에는 이자가 발생하고 상환금이 청구될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **새로운 상환 지원 플랜(RAP)**이 2026년 7월 1일부터 대출자들에게 제공될 예정입니다. 소득의 일정 비율로 월 상환금을 설정하고 최소 상환금이 존재하며, 장기 상환 기간이 지나면 대출 잔액을 탕감해 줍니다.

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **기타 소득 연계 상환 옵션이 축소됩니다.** PAYE 및 ICR과 같은 플랜은 향후 몇 년 안에 신규 신청이 중단될 예정이며, 대출자들은 일반적으로 표준 플랜과 RAP 중 하나를 선택해야 합니다. 소득 연계 상환(IBR)은 많은 이들에게 여전히 선택지로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **새로운 대출 한도 적용.** 2026년 중반 이후 처음 실행되는 대출의 경우 Grad PLUS가 폐지되었으며, 대학원생 및 학부모 Parent PLUS 대출에 연간 및 평생 한도가 적용됩니다. 이는 주로 미래의 학생들에게 영향이 있지만 가계 계획에도 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: 일정, 자격 요건 및 전환 규칙이 여러 번 변경되었으므로 본 요약을 포함한 모든 요약 내용은 시작점으로 삼고 본인의 옵션에 대한 최신 버전을 직접 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## 지금 이용할 수 있는 옵션

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **상환을 정상적으로 진행 중인 경우**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - StudentAid.gov 및 이용 중인 대출 서비스 기관 사이트에 로그인하세요. 가입된 플랜, 월 상환금, 납부 기일을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - SAVE 또는 단계적 폐지 예정인 다른 플랜을 이용 중이라면 언제 변경해야 하는지, 자격이 되는 플랜은 무엇인지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - StudentAid.gov의 Loan Simulator를 사용하여 각 플랜별 월 상환 금액과 총비용을 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **연체되었으나 채무 불이행 상태는 아닌 경우**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - 즉시 서비스 기관에 연락하세요. 저소득 가구의 경우 상환금을 크게 줄여줄 수 있는 소득 연계 플랜에 대해 문의하세요.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - 실직이나 경제적 어려움 등 자격 요건을 충족하는 어려움이 있다면 상환 유예(deferment 또는 forbearance)에 대해 문의하세요. 유예 기간 중에도 이자는 계속 발생할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - 연체 상태 해소 방법에 대해 문의하세요. 일부 서비스 기관은 계정을 정상 상태로 돌려 놓아 추가적인 연체 보고를 막아줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **대출이 채무 불이행(Default) 상태인 경우**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - **대출 재활(loan rehabilitation)** 제도를 알아보세요. 이는 보통 합의된 감당할 수 있는 수준의 월 상환금을 일정 기간 납부하는 방식입니다. 성공적으로 완료하면 이전의 연체 기록은 남을 수 있지만 신용 기록에서 채무 불이행 상태가 삭제될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - 채무 불이행 상태에서 벗어나는 또 다른 방법으로 Direct Consolidation Loan으로의 **대출 통합(loan consolidation)**을 고려해 보세요. 탕감 자격 판정을 위한 이행 기간 산정에 영향을 줄 수 있는 등 장단점이 있으므로 약관을 주의 깊게 읽어보세요.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - 급여 압류나 세금 환급금 상계를 중단하기 위한 옵션에 대해 문의하세요. 일반적으로 추심 대행기관이나 교육부에 직접 연락해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## 새해가 오기 전에 신용점수 피해를 줄이는 방법

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **결제 연체가 90일에 도달하지 않도록 하세요.** 보통 신용평가사 보고 기준일이 치명적인 지점이 됩니다. 그전에 서비스 기관에 전화하는 것이 가장 많은 옵션을 확보하는 방법입니다.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **자동 이체를 설정하세요.** 많은 서비스 기관이 자동 이체 시 소액의 금리 감면 혜택을 제공하며 실수로 인한 연체를 방지해 줍니다. 은행 계좌에 잔액이 충분한지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **청구 변경 사항을 주시하세요.** 플랜이 변경되면 월 상환금과 납부 기일도 변경될 수 있습니다. 서비스 기관의 모든 이메일과 공지 사항을 읽고 우편 주소와 연락처 정보를 확인하세요.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **신용 보고서를 확인하세요.** AnnualCreditReport.com에서 3대 신용평가사의 보고서를 무료로 발급받을 수 있습니다. 대출 상태와 잔액이 정확한지 검증하세요.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **오류에 대해 이의를 제기하세요.** 상환 유예 중이거나 처리 중인 상태에서 대출이 연체로 표시된 경우 해당 문제를 증빙하여 신용평가사 및 대출 서비스 기관에 이의를 신청하세요. 날짜, 담당자 이름, 통화 참조 번호 등의 기록을 보관하세요.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **기타 신용 상태를 건전하게 유지하세요.** 신용카드 잔액을 낮게 유지하고 다른 모든 공과금과 대금을 제때 납부하세요. 점수가 회복되는 동안 새로운 계좌를 여러 개 개설하지 마세요.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **제3자 업체를 주의하세요.** "학자금 대출 탕감"을 명목으로 선불 수수료를 요구하거나 신용 회복을 약속하는 회사들은 흔한 사기 유형입니다. 이들이 제공하는 모든 서비스는 일반적으로 대출 서비스 기관이나 StudentAid.gov를 통해 무료로 진행할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## 회복에는 얼마나 걸릴까?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: 연체 기록은 신용 보고서에 최대 7년 동안 남아있을 수 있지만, 이후 제때 납부한 기록을 쌓아가면 시간이 지남에 따라 그 영향은 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: 대출을 정상 상태로 돌리거나 대출 재활을 완료하면 신용점수가 점진적으로 회복될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: 결과는 개인의 전체적인 신용 상태에 따라 다르므로 특정 숫자를 단정 지어 기대하지는 마세요.

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## 간단한 연말 체크리스트

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - 상환 플랜과 필요한 변경 일자를 확인하세요.

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - 서비스 기관이 최신 전화번호, 이메일, 주소를 가지고 있는지 검증하세요.

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - 다음 상환 금액과 납부 기일을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - 신용 보고서를 발급받아 부정확한 학자금 대출 내역이 있는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - 연체가 발생한 후가 아닌, 발생하기 전에 서비스 기관에 연락하세요.

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - 절세 효과 고려: 소득 요건을 충족하면 학자금 대출 이자를 최대 $2,500까지 공제받을 수 있으므로 이자 납부 증명서(Form 1098-E)를 보관하세요.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: 연방 학자금 대출 규정이 전환기를 맞고 있으며, 아무런 조치를 취하지 않을 때 발생하는 비용이 커지고 있습니다.

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.

zh.title: 新规下的助学贷款：还款政策调整与信用分受损对借款人意味着什么

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: 一年多来，联邦助学贷款的还款政策一直处于不断变化之中。

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: 旧有的还款计划正在逐步取消，新的计划正在取而代之，许多出现逾期的借款人发现自己的信用报告受到了损害。

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: 如果你持有联邦助学贷款，现在是在年终截止日期和账单周期使问题变得更加棘手且代价更高之前，核查自己贷款状态的好时机。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *本文提供通用信息，不构成财务或法律建议。

segments.src: Program details change, so confirm current rules at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: 项目具体规定可能会有变动，请在 StudentAid.gov 或向你的贷款服务商确认最新规则。*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## 为什么这么多人的信用报告发生了变化

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: 最近出现的大多数困扰主要是由两项重大调整引起的。

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: 向信用局上报重新开始。** 在疫情期间的暂停还款政策下，联邦贷款的违约和逾期并未被上报。

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: 还款于 2023 年底重新开始，并设有一年的“过渡期（on-ramp）”以保护借款人免受逾期上报的影响。

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: 一旦该保护期结束，未按时还款的情况便再次开始出现在信用报告中。

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: 联邦数据以及纽约联邦储备银行的研究表明，大量借款人的信用评分有所下降，其中一些人的评分出现了大幅下跌。

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: 催收工作重新启动。** 政府于 2025 年恢复了对违约联邦贷款的催收。

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: 可能带来的后果包括财政部截留退税款项及其他联邦付款，以及行政性工资扣押。

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: 对于大多数联邦贷款而言，贷款通常在错失还款的次日即算作逾期，满 90 天后通常会被上报给信用局为晚还款，而在大约 270 天后则进入违约状态。

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: 还款历史是常见信用评分模型中最关键的单一因素。

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: 记录一次 90 天的逾期可能会显著降低评分，对于此前拥有良好信用记录的人来说尤为明显。

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## 还款政策有哪些变化

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: 2025 年通过的联邦立法以及针对旧计划的持续诉讼重塑了还款选项。

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: 需要了解的主要要点如下：

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **SAVE 计划正在终止。** 法院的诉讼裁决使借款人长期处于暂缓还款状态，该项目正在被逐步淘汰。已报名该计划的借款人需要转入其他计划。一旦你被转移，利息可能会累积，且需要按期还款。

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **新的还款援助计划（RAP）** 预计将于 2026 年 7 月 1 日起向借款人开放。它按收入的一定比例设定还款额，设有最低还款额，并在较长的还款期后提供贷款减免。

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **其他按收入调节的还款选项正在收紧。** PAYE 和 ICR 等计划预计将在未来几年内停止接受新报名，借款人通常预计将在标准计划与 RAP 之间做出选择。按收入还款（IBR）计划对许多人而言仍是一个可选方案。

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **新的贷款额度限制。** 对于在 2026 年年中之后首次发放的贷款，Grad PLUS 已被取消，且研究生贷款和 Parent PLUS 贷款将实行年度及终身总额封顶。这主要影响未来的学生，但也会影响家庭的财务规划。

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: 时间表、申请资格和过渡规则已发生多次变动，因此请将包括本文在内的任何总结仅视为起点，并务必核实你可选项的最新版本。

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## 你目前拥有的选项

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **如果你目前按时还款**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - 登录 StudentAid.gov 以及你贷款服务商的网站。确认你目前适用的还款计划、每月还款金额以及到期日。

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - 如果你参与的是 SAVE 计划或其他正在被逐步淘汰的计划，请弄清楚必须在何时进行转换，以及你有资格申请哪些新计划。

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - 使用 StudentAid.gov 上的贷款模拟器（Loan Simulator）比较各计划下的月还款额和总成本。

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **如果你已逾期但尚未违约**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - 立即联系你的贷款服务商。询问按收入调节的还款计划，该计划可以降低还款额，有时对低收入家庭的降幅相当大。

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - 如果你符合特定困难条件（如失业或经济困难），可询问延期还款（deferment）或暂缓还款（forbearance）。请注意，在此期间利息仍可能会累积。

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - 询问如何恢复正常还款状态。某些服务商可以帮助账户恢复顺畅，从而阻止产生进一步的逾期记录上报。

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **如果你的贷款已经违约**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - 了解**贷款修复（loan rehabilitation）**，这通常涉及按约定完成一系列负担得起的每月还款。成功完成后可以从你的信用历史中移除违约状态，尽管早期的逾期还款记录可能会保留。

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - 考虑将贷款**合并**为直接合并贷款（Direct Consolidation Loan），作为走出违约状态的另一种途径。这种做法权衡利弊（可能包括对豁免进度的潜在影响），因此请仔细阅读相关条款。

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - 询问有关停止工资扣押或退税截留的选项，这通常需要联系催收机构或美国教育部。

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## 新年到来前如何减少对信用评分的损害

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **切勿让还款逾期达到 90 天。** 上报门槛通常是分水岭。在此之前给你的贷款服务商打电话能为你争取到最多的解决选项。

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **设置自动扣款（autopay）。** 许多服务商为自动还款提供微幅的利率折扣，同时也能防止意外漏还。请确保银行账户内有足够的资金。

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **留意账单变动。** 当计划发生改变时，你的还款金额和到期日也可能会随之改变。阅读服务商发送的每一封电子邮件和通知，并检查你的邮寄地址及联系方式。

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **检查你的信用报告。** 你可以通过 AnnualCreditReport.com 从全部三家信用局获取免费报告。核实你的贷款状态和余额是否准确。

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **对错误提出异议。** 如果贷款在处于暂缓还款或处理期间被标记为逾期，请记录该问题，并向信用局及你的服务商提交异议申诉。保留日期、姓名和电话参考编号的记录。

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **保持其他信用良好。** 保持信用卡余额在较低水平，并按时支付所有其他账单。在你的信用评分恢复期间，避免开立多个新账户。

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **谨防第三方机构。** 那些收取预付费承诺“减免助学贷款”或承诺修护你信用的公司是常见的诈骗来源。他们提供的所有服务，你通常都可以通过你的服务商或 StudentAid.gov 免费办理。

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## 信用恢复需要多长时间？

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: 逾期付款记录最多可在信用报告中保留七年，但其影响会随着时间的推移而逐渐减弱，特别是如果你在此后建立了按时还款的记录。

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: 使贷款恢复正常或完成贷款修复可以使评分逐渐恢复。

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: 具体结果因你的整体信用状况而异，因此请避免期望获得一个具体的恢复数字。

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## 简短的年终核对清单

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - 确认你的还款计划以及任何所需变更的日期。

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - 核实你的服务商掌握有你最新的电话、电子邮件和地址。

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - 确认你下一次的还款金额和到期日。

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - 调取你的信用报告，查找不准确的助学贷款记录。

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - 在错失付款**之前**（而非之后）联系你的服务商。

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - 考虑税务影响：如果你符合收入限制，最多可以抵扣 $2,500 的助学贷款利息，因此请妥善保存你的利息清单（Form 1098-E）。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: 联邦助学贷款的规则正处于过渡期，不采取行动的代价正在上升。

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: 核查自己计划状态、与服务商保持联系并对任何错失的付款尽早采取行动的借款人，通常比那些拖延等待的人拥有多得多的选择。

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: 在接下来的几周里花一点时间，就能在迈入新年之际同时保护你的财务预算和信用评分。

segments.src: *Sources to check: StudentAid.gov, your loan servicer, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (consumerfinance.gov), and AnnualCreditReport.com.*
segments.tr: *可供核实的信息来源：StudentAid.gov、你的贷款服务商、美国消费者金融保护局 (consumerfinance.gov) 以及 AnnualCreditReport.com。*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## इतने सारे क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट क्यों बदल रहे हैं

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: दो मुख्य घटनाक्रम हाल की अधिकांश समस्याओं की व्याख्या करते हैं।

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: क्रेडिट ब्यूरो को रिपोर्टिंग फिर से शुरू हुई।** महामारी के दौर में भुगतान रोक (payment pause) के दौरान, संघीय ऋणों पर चूक (delinquency) की रिपोर्ट नहीं की गई थी।

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: 2023 के अंत में भुगतान फिर से शुरू हुए, और एक साल की "ऑन-रैंप" अवधि ने उधारकर्ताओं को रिपोर्ट की गई चूक से बचाया।

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: एक बार जब वह सुरक्षा समाप्त हो गई, तो छूटे हुए भुगतान फिर से क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट पर दिखाई देने लगे।

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: फेडरल रिज़र्व बैंक ऑफ़ न्यूयॉर्क के संघीय डेटा और शोध से पता चला है कि बड़ी संख्या में उधारकर्ताओं के स्कोर में गिरावट आई है, और कुछ में भारी गिरावट देखी गई है।

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: वसूली गतिविधियां (Collections activity) फिर से शुरू हुईं।** सरकार ने 2025 में डिफॉल्ट हुए संघीय ऋणों पर वसूली फिर से शुरू कर दी।

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: संभावित परिणामों में कर रिफंड और अन्य संघीय भुगतानों की ट्रेजरी कटौती (Treasury offset), और प्रशासनिक वेतन कुर्की (administrative wage garnishment) शामिल हैं।

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: भुगतान छूटने के अगले दिन ऋण आमतौर पर बकाया (delinquent) हो जाता है, 90 दिनों के बाद ब्यूरो को विलंब के रूप में रिपोर्ट किया जाता है, और अधिकांश संघीय ऋणों के लिए लगभग 270 दिनों के बाद डिफॉल्ट में प्रवेश करता है।

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: सामान्य स्कोरिंग मॉडल में भुगतान का इतिहास सबसे बड़ा एकल कारक है।

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट की गई 90-दिन की चूक स्कोर को काफी कम कर सकती है, खासकर उस व्यक्ति के लिए जिसका पहले का रिकॉर्ड बिल्कुल साफ था।

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## पुनर्भुगतान में क्या बदल रहा है

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: 2025 में पारित संघीय कानून और पुराने प्लानों पर चल रही मुकदमेबाजी ने पुनर्भुगतान विकल्पों का ढांचा बदल दिया है।

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: जानने योग्य मुख्य बातें:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **SAVE प्लान समाप्त हो रहा है।** अदालती कार्रवाइयों ने उधारकर्ताओं को एक लंबी सहनशीलता (forbearance) स्थिति में छोड़ दिया, और कार्यक्रम को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त किया जा रहा है। जो उधारकर्ता नामांकित थे, उन्हें दूसरे प्लान में जाना होगा। एक बार ट्रांसफर हो जाने पर ब्याज जमा हो सकता है और भुगतान देय होगा।

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **एक नया पुनर्भुगतान सहायता प्लान (RAP)** उधारकर्ताओं के लिए 1 जुलाई, 2026 से उपलब्ध होने का कार्यक्रम है। यह आय के प्रतिशत के रूप में न्यूनतम भुगतान के साथ किश्तें निर्धारित करता है, और लंबी पुनर्भुगतान अवधि के बाद ऋण माफी की पेशकश करता है।

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **अन्य आय-आधारित विकल्प सीमित हो रहे हैं।** PAYE और ICR जैसे प्लान आने वाले वर्षों में नए नामांकन के लिए बंद होने वाले हैं, और उधारकर्ताओं से आमतौर पर एक मानक प्लान और RAP के बीच चयन करने की उम्मीद की जाती है। आय-आधारित पुनर्भुगतान (IBR) कई लोगों के लिए एक विकल्प बना हुआ है।

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **ऋण लेने की नई सीमाएं।** 2026 के मध्य के बाद पहली बार वितरित किए गए ऋणों के लिए, Grad PLUS को समाप्त कर दिया गया है और स्नातक तथा Parent PLUS ऋणों पर वार्षिक एवं जीवनकाल की सीमाएं लागू होती हैं। यह मुख्य रूप से भविष्य के छात्रों के लिए मायने रखता है, लेकिन यह पारिवारिक नियोजन को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: समय सीमा, पात्रता और संक्रमण के नियम कई बार बदले हैं, इसलिए इस विवरण सहित किसी भी सारांश को एक शुरुआती बिंदु के रूप में लें और अपने विकल्पों के वर्तमान संस्करण का सत्यापन करें।

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## अभी आपके पास क्या विकल्प हैं

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **यदि आप भुगतानों पर नियमित (current) हैं**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - StudentAid.gov और अपने सेवा प्रदाता (servicer) की साइट पर लॉग इन करें। पुष्टि करें कि आप किस प्लान पर हैं, आपकी मासिक राशि क्या है, और आपकी देय तिथि क्या है।

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - यदि आप SAVE या समाप्त किए जा रहे किसी अन्य प्लान पर हैं, तो पता करें कि आपको कब स्विच करना होगा और आप किन प्लानों के लिए योग्य हैं।

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - प्रत्येक प्लान के तहत भुगतान राशि और कुल लागत की तुलना करने के लिए StudentAid.gov पर लोन सिम्युलेटर (Loan Simulator) का उपयोग करें।

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **यदि आप पीछे चल रहे हैं लेकिन डिफॉल्ट में नहीं हैं**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - तुरंत अपने सेवा प्रदाता से संपर्क करें। आय-आधारित प्लान के बारे में पूछें, जो कम आय वाले परिवारों के लिए भुगतान को कभी-कभी काफी कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - यदि आपके पास कोई अर्हक कठिनाई (qualifying hardship) है, जैसे बेरोजगारी या आर्थिक तंगी, तो स्थगन (deferment) या सहनशीलता (forbearance) के बारे में पूछें। ध्यान दें कि ब्याज अभी भी जमा हो सकता है।

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - खाते को नियमित (current) करने के बारे में पूछें। कुछ सेवा प्रदाता खाते को अप-टू-डेट कर सकते हैं, जिससे आगे की विलंब रिपोर्ट रुक जाती है।

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **यदि आपका ऋण डिफॉल्ट में है**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - **ऋण पुनर्वास (loan rehabilitation)** पर विचार करें, जिसमें आमतौर पर सहमत, किफायती मासिक भुगतानों की एक श्रृंखला शामिल होती है। इसे सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करने से आपकी क्रेडिट हिस्ट्री से डिफॉल्ट स्थिति हट सकती है, हालांकि पहले के देर से किए गए भुगतान बने रह सकते हैं।

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - डिफॉल्ट से बाहर निकलने के दूसरे रास्ते के रूप में डायरेक्ट कंसॉलिडेशन लोन (Direct Consolidation Loan) में **ऋण समेकन (loan consolidation)** पर विचार करें। इसके कुछ नुकसान भी हैं, जिसमें क्षमा (forgiveness) की ओर प्रगति पर संभावित प्रभाव शामिल है, इसलिए शर्तों को ध्यान से पढ़ें।

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - वेतन कुर्की या टैक्स रिफंड की कटौती को रोकने के विकल्पों के बारे में पूछें, जिसके लिए आमतौर पर कलेक्शन एजेंसी या शिक्षा विभाग से संपर्क करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## नए साल से पहले क्रेडिट स्कोर के नुकसान को कैसे सीमित करें

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **किसी भुगतान को 90 दिनों की देरी तक न पहुंचने दें।** रिपोर्टिंग सीमाएं आमतौर पर मुख्य जोखिम बिंदु होती हैं। उससे पहले आपके सेवा प्रदाता को की गई एक कॉल आपको सबसे अधिक विकल्प देती है।

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **ऑटोपे (autopay) सेट करें।** कई सेवा प्रदाता स्वचालित भुगतानों के लिए ब्याज दर में थोड़ी छूट देते हैं, और यह अनजाने में भुगतान छूटने से बचाता है। सुनिश्चित करें कि बैंक खाते में पर्याप्त धनराशि है।

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **बिलिंग परिवर्तनों पर नज़र रखें।** जब कोई प्लान बदलता है, तो आपकी भुगतान राशि और देय तिथि भी बदल सकती है। सेवा प्रदाता के हर ईमेल और नोटिस को पढ़ें, और अपने पत्राचार के पते तथा संपर्क जानकारी की जांच करें।

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **अपनी क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट जांचें।** आप AnnualCreditReport.com से तीनों ब्यूरो से मुफ्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। सत्यापित करें कि आपकी ऋण स्थिति और शेष राशि सटीक हैं।

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **त्रुटियों पर विवाद दर्ज करें।** यदि किसी ऋण को सहनशीलता के दौरान या प्रक्रियाधीन रहने के दौरान बकाया (delinquent) के रूप में चिह्नित किया जाता है, तो समस्या का दस्तावेजीकरण करें और ब्यूरो व अपने सेवा प्रदाता के पास विवाद दर्ज करें। तारीखों, नामों और कॉल संदर्भ नंबरों का रिकॉर्ड रखें।

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **अन्य क्रेडिट को स्वस्थ रखें।** क्रेडिट कार्ड की शेष राशि कम रखें और अन्य सभी बिलों का भुगतान समय पर करें। जब आपका स्कोर सुधर रहा हो तो कई नए खाते खोलने से बचें।

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **तीसरे पक्षों से सावधान रहें।** जो कंपनियां "छात्र ऋण माफी" के लिए अग्रिम शुल्क लेती हैं या आपके क्रेडिट को ठीक करने का वादा करती हैं, वे धोखाधड़ी का एक आम स्रोत हैं। वे जो कुछ भी पेश करते हैं, वह आप आमतौर पर अपने सेवा प्रदाता या StudentAid.gov के माध्यम से मुफ्त में कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## सुधार में कितना समय लगता है?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: विलंबित भुगतान क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट पर सात साल तक रह सकते हैं, लेकिन समय के साथ उनका प्रभाव कम हो जाता है, खासकर यदि आप उसके बाद समय पर भुगतान का रिकॉर्ड बनाते हैं।

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: ऋण को नियमित करने या पुनर्वास (rehabilitation) पूरा करने से स्कोर में धीरे-धीरे सुधार हो सकता है।

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: परिणाम आपकी बाकी क्रेडिट प्रोफ़ाइल के आधार पर भिन्न होते हैं, इसलिए किसी विशिष्ट संख्या की उम्मीद करने से बचें।

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## वर्ष के अंत की एक संक्षिप्त चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - अपने पुनर्भुगतान प्लान और किसी भी आवश्यक परिवर्तन की तिथि की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - सत्यापित करें कि आपके सेवा प्रदाता के पास आपका वर्तमान फोन, ईमेल और पता है।

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - अपनी अगली भुगतान राशि और देय तिथि की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - अपनी क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट निकालें और गलत छात्र ऋण प्रविष्टियों की तलाश करें।

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - भुगतान छूटने के बाद नहीं, बल्कि छूटने से पहले अपने सेवा प्रदाता से संपर्क करें।

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - कर प्रभावों पर विचार करें: यदि आप आय सीमाओं को पूरा करते हैं तो आप छात्र ऋण ब्याज के $2,500 तक की कटौती करने में सक्षम हो सकते हैं, इसलिए अपने ब्याज विवरण (Form 1098-E) संभाल कर रखें।

segments.src: ## The bottom line

es.title: Préstamos estudiantiles bajo las nuevas reglas: Qué significan para los prestatarios los cambios en los pagos y las caídas en el puntaje crediticio

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: El pago de préstamos estudiantiles federales ha estado en constante cambio durante más de un año.

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: Los planes más antiguos se están eliminando, los nuevos están tomando su lugar y muchos prestatarios que se retrasaron están encontrando daños en sus informes de crédito.

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: Si tienes préstamos estudiantiles federales, ahora es un buen momento para verificar tu estado, antes de que los plazos de fin de año y los ciclos de facturación encarezcan cualquier problema.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es información general, no asesoramiento financiero o legal.

segments.src: Program details change, so confirm current rules at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Los detalles del programa cambian, así que confirma las reglas actuales en StudentAid.gov o con tu administrador de préstamos.*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## Por qué tantos informes de crédito están cambiando

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: Dos acontecimientos explican la mayor parte de los problemas recientes.

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: Se reanudó el reporte a las agencias de crédito.** Durante la pausa de pagos de la era de la pandemia, los atrasos en los préstamos federales no se reportaron.

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: Los pagos se reiniciaron a finales de 2023, y un período de "incorporación" (on-ramp) de un año protegió a los prestatarios de los atrasos reportados.

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: Una vez que terminó esa protección, los pagos atrasados comenzaron a aparecer nuevamente en los informes de crédito.

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: Los datos federales y la investigación del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York han demostrado que un gran número de prestatarios vieron caer sus puntajes, y que algunos experimentaron caídas drásticas.

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: Se reanudó la actividad de cobranza.** El gobierno reanudó la cobranza de préstamos federales en mora en 2025.

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: Las posibles consecuencias incluyen la compensación del Tesoro de reembolsos de impuestos y otros pagos federales, y el embargo administrativo de salarios.

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: Un préstamo generalmente se considera en retraso el día después de un pago no realizado, normalmente se reporta como atrasado a las agencias después de 90 días y entra en default (incumplimiento) después de unos 270 días para la mayoría de los préstamos federales.

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: El historial de pagos es el factor individual más importante en los modelos de puntuación comunes.

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: Un retraso reportado de 90 días puede reducir significativamente un puntaje, especialmente para alguien que anteriormente tenía un historial limpio.

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## Qué está cambiando en los pagos

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: La legislación federal aprobada en 2025 y los litigios en curso sobre planes anteriores han reformado el menú de pagos.

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: Los puntos principales que debes conocer:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **El plan SAVE está terminando.** Las acciones judiciales dejaron a los prestatarios en una larga suspensión de pagos (forbearance), y el programa se está eliminando gradualmente. Los prestatarios que estaban inscritos deben cambiar a otro plan. Es posible que se acumulen intereses y los pagos se vencieran una vez que te cambies.

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **Un nuevo Plan de Asistencia para el Pago (RAP)** está programado para estar disponible para los prestatarios a partir del 1 de julio de 2026. Establece los pagos como un porcentaje de los ingresos, con un pago mínimo, y ofrece la condonación del préstamo después de un largo período de pago.

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **Otras opciones basadas en los ingresos se están reduciendo.** Los planes como PAYE e ICR están programados para cerrar a nuevas inscripciones en los próximos años, y generalmente se espera que los prestatarios elijan entre un plan estándar y el RAP. El Pago Basado en Ingresos (IBR) sigue siendo una opción para muchos.

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **Nuevos límites de préstamo.** Para los préstamos desembolsados por primera vez después de mediados de 2026, Grad PLUS ha sido eliminado y se aplican límites anuales y de por vida a los préstamos para estudios de posgrado y Parent PLUS. Esto importa principalmente para futuros estudiantes, pero afecta la planificación familiar.

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: Los cronogramas, la elegibilidad y las reglas de transición han cambiado varias veces, así que trata cualquier resumen, incluido este, como un punto de partida y verifica la versión actual de tus opciones.

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## Tus opciones en este momento

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **Si estás al día con los pagos**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - Inicia sesión en StudentAid.gov y en el sitio de tu administrador. Confirma en qué plan estás, tu monto mensual y tu fecha de vencimiento.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - Si estás en SAVE u otro plan que se está eliminando, averigua cuándo debes cambiarte y para qué planes calificas.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - Utiliza el Simulador de Préstamos en StudentAid.gov para comparar los montos de pago y el costo total bajo cada plan.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **Si estás atrasado pero no en incumplimiento (default)**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - Comunícate con tu administrador de inmediato. Pregunta sobre un plan basado en los ingresos, que puede reducir el pago, a veces drásticamente para los hogares de menores ingresos.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - Pregunta sobre el aplazamiento (deferment) o la suspensión de pagos (forbearance) si tienes una dificultad elegible, como desempleo o dificultad económica. Ten en cuenta que los intereses aún pueden acumularse.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - Pregunta sobre cómo ponerte al día. Algunos administradores pueden actualizar una cuenta, lo que detiene futuros reportes de retraso.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **Si tu préstamo está en incumplimiento (default)**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - Analiza la **rehabilitación de préstamos**, que generalmente implica una serie de pagos mensuales acordados y asequibles. Completarla con éxito puede eliminar el estado de incumplimiento de tu historial crediticio, aunque los pagos atrasados anteriores pueden permanecer.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - Considera la **consolidación de préstamos** en un Préstamo de Consolidación Directa como otra vía para salir del incumplimiento. Tiene desventajas, incluido un posible efecto en el progreso hacia la condonación, así que lee los términos detenidamente.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - Pregunta sobre las opciones para detener el embargo de salarios o la compensación de reembolsos de impuestos, que por lo general requieren comunicarse con la agencia de cobranza o el Departamento de Educación.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## Cómo limitar el daño al puntaje crediticio antes de año nuevo

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **No dejes que un pago alcance los 90 días de retraso.** Los umbrales de reporte suelen ser el límite crítico. Una llamada a tu administrador antes de eso te ofrece la mayor cantidad de opciones.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **Configura el pago automático.** Muchos administradores ofrecen una pequeña reducción en la tasa de interés por los pagos automáticos, y esto evita olvidos accidentales. Asegúrate de que la cuenta bancaria tenga suficientes fondos.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **Vigila los cambios de facturación.** Cuando un plan cambia, tu monto de pago y fecha de vencimiento también pueden hacerlo. Lee cada correo electrónico y aviso del administrador, y verifica tu dirección postal e información de contacto.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **Revisa tus informes de crédito.** Puedes obtener informes gratuitos de las tres agencias en AnnualCreditReport.com. Verifica que los estados y saldos de tus préstamos sean precisos.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **Discute los errores.** Si un préstamo se marca como atrasado mientras estaba en suspensión de pagos o en proceso, documenta el problema y presenta una disputa ante la agencia y tu administrador. Mantén registros de fechas, nombres y números de referencia de llamadas.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **Mantén saludable tu otro crédito.** Mantén bajos los saldos de las tarjetas de crédito y paga todas las demás facturas a tiempo. Evita abrir varias cuentas nuevas mientras tu puntaje se está recuperando.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **Ten cuidado con terceros.** Las empresas que cobran tarifas por adelantado para la "condonación de préstamos estudiantiles" o prometen arreglar tu crédito son una fuente frecuente de estafas. Todo lo que ofrecen, generalmente puedes hacerlo gratis a través de tu administrador o StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## ¿Cuánto tiempo toma la recuperación?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: Los pagos atrasados pueden permanecer en un informe de crédito por hasta siete años, pero su impacto disminuye con el tiempo, especialmente si construyes un historial de pagos a tiempo después.

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: Poner al día un préstamo o completar la rehabilitación puede conducir a una recuperación gradual del puntaje.

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: Los resultados varían según el resto de tu perfil crediticio, así que evita esperar un número específico.

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## Una breve lista de verificación de fin de año

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - Confirma tu plan de pago y la fecha de cualquier cambio requerido.

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - Verifica que tu administrador tenga tu teléfono, correo electrónico y dirección actuales.

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - Confirma el monto de tu próximo pago y la fecha de vencimiento.

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - Obtén tus informes de crédito y busca entradas inexactas de préstamos estudiantiles.

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - Comunícate con tu administrador antes, no después, de que se pase por alto un pago.

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - Considera los efectos fiscales: es posible que puedas deducir hasta $2,500 en intereses de préstamos estudiantiles si cumples con los límites de ingresos, así que guarda tus declaraciones de intereses (Formulario 1098-E).

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: Las reglas para los préstamos estudiantiles federales están en transición y el costo de la inacción está aumentando.

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: Los prestatarios que verifican el estado de su plan, se mantienen en contacto con su administrador y actúan con anticipación ante cualquier pago atrasado generalmente tienen muchas más opciones que aquellos que esperan.

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: Un poco de tiempo dedicado en las próximas semanas puede proteger tanto tu presupuesto como tu puntaje crediticio de cara al año nuevo.

segments.tr: **Si vous êtes à jour dans vos paiements**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - Connectez-vous à StudentAid.gov et au site de votre gestionnaire de prêt. Vérifiez quel plan vous suivez, le montant de vos mensualités et votre date d'échéance.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - Si vous êtes sur SAVE ou un autre plan en cours de suppression, renseignez-vous sur la date à laquelle vous devez changer et sur les plans auxquels vous êtes éligible.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - Utilisez le Loan Simulator de StudentAid.gov pour comparer les montants des mensualités et le coût total de chaque plan.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **Si vous avez du retard sans être en défaut**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - Contactez immédiatement votre gestionnaire de prêt. Demandez un plan lié aux revenus, qui peut réduire la mensualité, parfois fortement pour les ménages à faibles revenus.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - Demandez un report (deferment) ou une forbearance si vous êtes dans une situation difficile éligible, comme le chômage ou des difficultés économiques. Notez que des intérêts peuvent quand même courir.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - Demandez à être remis à jour. Certains gestionnaires peuvent régulariser un compte, ce qui met fin aux signalements de retard.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **Si votre prêt est en défaut**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - Renseignez-vous sur la **réhabilitation du prêt**, qui consiste généralement en une série de mensualités convenues et abordables. Si vous la menez à bien, le statut de défaut peut disparaître de votre historique de crédit, même si les retards antérieurs peuvent rester.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - Envisagez la **consolidation du prêt** dans un Direct Consolidation Loan comme autre moyen de sortir du défaut. Elle a des inconvénients, notamment un possible effet sur la progression vers l'annulation de la dette ; lisez attentivement les conditions.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - Renseignez-vous sur les options pour arrêter la saisie sur salaire ou la compensation sur les remboursements d'impôts, qui nécessitent généralement de contacter l'agence de recouvrement ou le Department of Education.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## Comment limiter l'impact sur le score de crédit avant la nouvelle année

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **Ne laissez jamais un paiement atteindre 90 jours de retard.** Les seuils de signalement sont généralement la limite critique. Un appel à votre gestionnaire avant ce seuil vous laisse le plus d'options.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **Mettez en place le prélèvement automatique.** Beaucoup de gestionnaires offrent une petite réduction du taux d'intérêt pour les paiements automatiques, et cela évite les oublis accidentels. Vérifiez que le compte bancaire dispose de fonds suffisants.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **Surveillez les changements de facturation.** Quand un plan change, le montant de vos paiements et votre date d'échéance peuvent aussi changer. Lisez chaque courriel et chaque avis du gestionnaire, et vérifiez votre adresse postale et vos coordonnées.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **Vérifiez vos rapports de crédit.** Vous pouvez obtenir gratuitement les rapports des trois bureaux sur AnnualCreditReport.com. Assurez-vous que le statut et le solde de vos prêts sont exacts.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **Contestez les erreurs.** Si un prêt est marqué en retard alors qu'il était en forbearance ou en cours de traitement, documentez le problème et déposez une contestation auprès du bureau de crédit et de votre gestionnaire. Conservez les dates, les noms et les numéros de référence des appels.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **Entretenez vos autres crédits.** Gardez bas le solde de vos cartes de crédit et payez toutes vos autres factures à temps. Évitez d'ouvrir plusieurs nouveaux comptes pendant que votre score se rétablit.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **Méfiez-vous des intermédiaires.** Les sociétés qui facturent des frais à l'avance pour une « annulation de prêt étudiant » ou qui promettent de réparer votre crédit sont une source fréquente d'arnaques. Tout ce qu'elles proposent, vous pouvez généralement le faire gratuitement via votre gestionnaire ou StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## Combien de temps prend le rétablissement ?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: Les retards de paiement peuvent rester dans un dossier de crédit jusqu'à sept ans, mais leur impact s'estompe avec le temps, surtout si vous accumulez ensuite un historique de paiements à temps.

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: Remettre un prêt à jour ou mener à bien une réhabilitation peut entraîner une remontée progressive du score.

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: Les résultats varient selon le reste de votre profil de crédit ; évitez donc d'attendre un chiffre précis.

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## Une courte liste de contrôle de fin d'année

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - Confirmez votre plan de remboursement et la date de tout changement obligatoire.

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - Vérifiez que votre gestionnaire dispose de votre téléphone, de votre courriel et de votre adresse actuels.

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - Confirmez le montant et la date d'échéance de votre prochain paiement.

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - Consultez vos rapports de crédit et recherchez les inscriptions erronées concernant vos prêts étudiants.

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - Contactez votre gestionnaire avant qu'un paiement ne soit manqué, et non après.

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - Pensez aux effets fiscaux : vous pourriez déduire jusqu'à 2 500 $ d'intérêts d'emprunt étudiant si vous respectez les plafonds de revenus ; conservez vos relevés d'intérêts (formulaire 1098-E).

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En bref

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: Les règles applicables aux prêts étudiants fédéraux sont en transition, et le coût de l'inaction augmente.

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: Les emprunteurs qui vérifient leur plan, restent en contact avec leur gestionnaire et agissent tôt dès qu'un paiement est manqué ont généralement bien plus d'options que ceux qui attendent.

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: Quelques heures consacrées dans les prochaines semaines peuvent protéger à la fois votre budget et votre score de crédit à l'approche de la nouvelle année.
