pt.title: Empréstimos estudantis sob as novas regras: o que muda no pagamento e o impacto na pontuação de crédito para os tomadores

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: O regime de pagamento dos empréstimos estudantis federais está em transição há mais de um ano.

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: Planos antigos estão sendo encerrados, novos estão tomando o lugar, e muitos tomadores que ficaram para trás estão descobrindo os danos em seus relatórios de crédito.

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: Se você tem empréstimos estudantis federais, agora é um bom momento para verificar sua situação, antes que os prazos de fim de ano e os ciclos de cobrança tornem qualquer problema mais caro.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo traz informações gerais, não aconselhamento financeiro ou jurídico.

segments.src: Program details change, so confirm current rules at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Os detalhes dos programas mudam, então confirme as regras atuais em StudentAid.gov ou com o seu agente de empréstimos (servicer).*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## Por que tantos relatórios de crédito estão mudando

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: Dois desdobramentos explicam a maior parte dos problemas recentes.

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: A informação aos bureaus de crédito foi retomada.** Durante a suspensão de pagamentos da era da pandemia, os atrasos em empréstimos federais não eram informados.

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: Os pagamentos recomeçaram no fim de 2023, e um período de "transição" (on-ramp) de um ano protegeu os tomadores de atrasos informados.

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: Quando essa proteção terminou, os pagamentos em atraso voltaram a aparecer nos relatórios de crédito.

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: Dados federais e pesquisas do Federal Reserve Bank de Nova York mostraram que um grande número de tomadores viu sua pontuação cair, e que alguns viram quedas grandes.

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: A cobrança foi retomada.** O governo retomou a cobrança de empréstimos federais em inadimplência em 2025.

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: As consequências possíveis incluem a retenção pelo Tesouro de restituições de imposto de renda e de outros pagamentos federais, e o desconto administrativo em salário.

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: Um empréstimo geralmente entra em atraso no dia seguinte a um pagamento perdido, normalmente é informado como atrasado aos bureaus após 90 dias, e passa à inadimplência após cerca de 270 dias para a maioria dos empréstimos federais.

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: O histórico de pagamentos é o fator individual mais importante nos modelos de pontuação comuns.

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: Um atraso de 90 dias informado pode reduzir significativamente a pontuação, especialmente para quem tinha um histórico limpo antes.

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## O que está mudando no pagamento

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: A legislação federal aprovada em 2025 e os processos judiciais em andamento sobre os planos antigos remodelaram o menu de pagamentos.

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: Os pontos principais a saber:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **O plano SAVE está chegando ao fim.** Decisões judiciais deixaram os tomadores em uma longa suspensão temporária (forbearance), e o programa está sendo eliminado gradualmente. Os tomadores que estavam inscritos precisam migrar para outro plano. Os juros podem continuar sendo acumulados, e os pagamentos voltarão a ser devidos assim que você for migrado.

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **Um novo Plano de Assistência ao Pagamento (RAP)** está previsto para ficar disponível aos tomadores a partir de 1º de julho de 2026. Ele define pagamentos como percentual da renda, com um pagamento mínimo, e oferece perdão de dívida após um longo período de pagamento.

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **Outras opções baseadas na renda estão diminuindo.** Planos como PAYE e ICR devem ser fechados a novas inscrições nos próximos anos, e espera-se que os tomadores escolham, em geral, entre um plano padrão e o RAP. O Plano de Pagamento Baseado na Renda (IBR) continua disponível para muitos.

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **Novos limites de empréstimo.** Para empréstimos cujo primeiro desembolso ocorra após meados de 2026, o Grad PLUS foi eliminado, e limites anuais e vitalícios passam a valer para os empréstimos de pós-graduação e os Parent PLUS. Isso afeta principalmente futuros estudantes, mas também impacta o planejamento familiar.

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: Os prazos, a elegibilidade e as regras de transição já mudaram várias vezes, então trate qualquer resumo, inclusive este, como um ponto de partida e verifique a versão atual das suas opções.

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## Suas opções agora

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **Se você está em dia com os pagamentos**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - Entre no StudentAid.gov e no site do seu agente de empréstimos. Confirme em qual plano você está, o valor mensal e a data de vencimento.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - Se você está no SAVE ou em outro plano em eliminação, descubra quando precisa mudar e quais planos você pode acessar.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - Use o Simulador de Empréstimos no StudentAid.gov para comparar os valores de pagamento e o custo total em cada plano.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **Se você está atrasado, mas não em inadimplência**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - Entre em contato com seu agente de empréstimos imediatamente. Pergunte sobre um plano baseado na renda, que pode reduzir o pagamento, às vezes de forma acentuada para famílias de baixa renda.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - Pergunte sobre adiamento (deferment) ou suspensão temporária (forbearance) se você tiver uma dificuldade qualificada, como desemprego ou dificuldade econômica. Observe que os juros ainda podem continuar sendo acumulados.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - Pergunte sobre como ficar em dia. Alguns agentes podem regularizar a conta, o que interrompe novos relatórios de atraso.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **Se o seu empréstimo está em inadimplência**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - Veja a **reabilitação do empréstimo**, que normalmente envolve uma série de pagamentos mensais acordados e acessíveis. Concluí-la com sucesso pode remover o status de inadimplência do seu histórico de crédito, embora atrasos anteriores possam permanecer.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - Considere a **consolidação do empréstimo** em um Direct Consolidation Loan como outra saída da inadimplência. Ela tem contrapartidas, incluindo um possível efeito sobre o progresso rumo ao perdão, então leia as condições com atenção.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - Pergunte sobre opções para interromper o desconto em salário ou a retenção de restituição de imposto, que normalmente exigem contato com a agência de cobrança ou com o Departamento de Educação.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## Como limitar o dano à pontuação de crédito antes do novo ano

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **Não deixe um pagamento chegar a 90 dias de atraso.** Os limites de informação costumam ser o ponto crítico. Um contato com o seu agente antes disso oferece mais opções.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **Configure o débito automático.** Muitos agentes oferecem uma pequena redução na taxa de juros para pagamentos automáticos, e isso evita perdas acidentais. Certifique-se de que a conta bancária tenha saldo suficiente.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **Fique atento a mudanças na cobrança.** Quando um plano muda, o valor do pagamento e a data de vencimento também podem mudar. Leia todos os e-mails e avisos do agente e confira seu endereço postal e suas informações de contato.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **Verifique seus relatórios de crédito.** Você pode obter relatórios gratuitos dos três bureaus em AnnualCreditReport.com. Confirme se os status e saldos dos seus empréstimos estão corretos.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **Conteste erros.** Se um empréstimo aparece como em atraso enquanto estava em suspensão temporária ou sendo processado, documente o problema e registre uma contestação junto ao bureau e ao seu agente. Guarde registros de datas, nomes e números de protocolo das ligações.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **Mantenha o restante do crédito saudável.** Mantenha baixos os saldos dos cartões de crédito e pague todas as outras contas em dia. Evite abrir várias contas novas enquanto sua pontuação se recupera.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **Cuidado com terceiros.** Empresas que cobram taxas antecipadas por "perdão de empréstimo estudantil" ou prometem consertar seu crédito são uma fonte frequente de golpes. Tudo o que elas oferecem, você geralmente pode fazer gratuitamente pelo seu agente ou pelo StudentAid.gov.

segments.tr: ## Quanto tempo leva a recuperação?

segments.tr: ## Resumo final

in.title: Pinjaman Mahasiswa Berdasarkan Aturan Baru: Perubahan Pembayaran dan Dampak Skor Kredit bagi Peminjam

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: Pembayaran pinjaman mahasiswa federal sudah tidak stabil selama lebih dari setahun.

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: Paket lama sedang dihentikan secara bertahap, paket baru menggantikannya, dan banyak peminjam yang tertinggal pembayarannya kini menemukan kerusakannya di laporan kredit mereka.

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: Jika Anda memegang pinjaman mahasiswa federal, sekarang adalah waktu yang baik untuk memeriksa status Anda, sebelum tenggat akhir tahun dan siklus tagihan membuat masalah apa pun menjadi lebih mahal.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini berisi informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau hukum.

segments.src: Program details change, so confirm current rules at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Rincian program dapat berubah, jadi pastikan aturan terkini di StudentAid.gov atau kepada pengelola pinjaman Anda.*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## Mengapa begitu banyak laporan kredit berubah

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: Dua perkembangan menjelaskan sebagian besar masalah belakangan ini.

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: Pelaporan ke biro kredit dilanjutkan.** Selama masa jeda pembayaran era pandemi, tunggakan pinjaman federal tidak dilaporkan.

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: Pembayaran dimulai kembali pada akhir 2023, dan periode masa transisi "on-ramp" selama satu tahun melindungi peminjam dari pelaporan tunggakan.

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: Setelah perlindungan itu berakhir, pembayaran yang terlewat mulai muncul kembali di laporan kredit.

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: Data federal dan penelitian dari Federal Reserve Bank of New York menunjukkan bahwa sejumlah besar peminjam mengalami penurunan skor, dan sebagian mengalami penurunan yang besar.

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: Aktivitas penagihan dilanjutkan.** Pemerintah melanjutkan penagihan atas pinjaman federal yang gagal bayar pada 2025.

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: Konsekuensi yang mungkin terjadi meliputi pemotongan (offset) oleh Departemen Keuangan AS atas pengembalian pajak dan pembayaran federal lainnya, serta pemotongan upah administratif.

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: Pinjaman umumnya menjadi menunggak sehari setelah pembayaran terlewat, biasanya dilaporkan terlambat ke biro kredit setelah 90 hari, dan masuk ke status gagal bayar (default) sekitar 270 hari untuk sebagian besar pinjaman federal.

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: Riwayat pembayaran adalah faktor tunggal terbesar dalam model penilaian kredit umum.

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: Tunggakan 90 hari yang dilaporkan dapat menurunkan skor secara signifikan, terutama bagi seseorang yang sebelumnya memiliki catatan bersih.

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## Apa yang berubah dalam pembayaran

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: Undang-undang federal yang disahkan pada 2025 dan litigasi yang sedang berjalan terkait paket lama telah membentuk ulang pilihan pembayaran.

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: Poin-poin utama yang perlu diketahui:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **Rencana SAVE akan berakhir.** Tindakan pengadilan membuat peminjam berada dalam penangguhan panjang, dan program ini sedang dihentikan secara bertahap. Peminjam yang terdaftar perlu pindah ke paket lain. Bunga mungkin terakumulasi dan pembayaran akan jatuh tempo setelah Anda dipindahkan.

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **Rencana Bantuan Pembayaran (Repayment Assistance Plan/RAP) yang baru** dijadwalkan tersedia bagi peminjam mulai 1 Juli 2026. Pembayaran ditetapkan sebagai persentase dari pendapatan, dengan pembayaran minimum, dan menawarkan penghapusan pinjaman setelah periode pembayaran yang panjang.

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **Opsi pembayaran berbasis pendapatan lainnya semakin sempit.** Paket seperti PAYE dan ICR dijadwalkan ditutup untuk pendaftaran baru dalam beberapa tahun mendatang, dan peminjam umumnya diharapkan memilih antara paket standar dan RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) tetap menjadi opsi bagi banyak peminjam.

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **Batas peminjaman baru.** Untuk pinjaman yang pertama kali dicairkan setelah pertengahan 2026, Grad PLUS dihapus dan batas tahunan serta seumur hidup berlaku untuk pinjaman Graduate dan Parent PLUS. Ini terutama berdampak pada calon mahasiswa, tetapi juga memengaruhi perencanaan keluarga.

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: Jadwal, kelayakan, dan aturan transisi telah berubah beberapa kali, jadi anggap setiap ringkasan, termasuk yang ini, sebagai titik awal dan verifikasi versi terkini dari pilihan Anda.

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## Pilihan Anda saat ini

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **Jika pembayaran Anda lancar**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - Masuk ke StudentAid.gov dan situs pengelola pinjaman Anda. Pastikan paket mana yang Anda gunakan, jumlah bulanan, dan tanggal jatuh tempo Anda.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - Jika Anda berada di SAVE atau paket lain yang sedang dihentikan, cari tahu kapan Anda harus berpindah dan paket mana yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - Gunakan Simulator Pinjaman di StudentAid.gov untuk membandingkan jumlah pembayaran dan total biaya di setiap paket.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **Jika Anda tertinggal tetapi belum gagal bayar**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - Segera hubungi pengelola pinjaman Anda. Tanyakan tentang paket berbasis pendapatan, yang dapat menurunkan pembayaran, kadang secara drastis bagi rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - Tanyakan tentang penundaan (deferment) atau penangguhan (forbearance) jika Anda memiliki kesulitan yang memenuhi syarat, seperti pengangguran atau kesulitan ekonomi. Perhatikan bahwa bunga mungkin tetap terakumulasi.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - Tanyakan cara melunasi tunggakan. Beberapa pengelola dapat memutakhirkan akun, yang menghentikan laporan keterlambatan lebih lanjut.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **Jika pinjaman Anda gagal bayar**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - Pertimbangkan **rehabilitasi pinjaman**, yang biasanya berupa serangkaian pembayaran bulanan yang disepakati dan terjangkau. Menyelesaikannya dengan sukses dapat menghapus status gagal bayar dari riwayat kredit Anda, meskipun keterlambatan pembayaran sebelumnya mungkin tetap ada.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - Pertimbangkan **konsolidasi pinjaman** ke dalam Direct Consolidation Loan sebagai jalur lain untuk keluar dari gagal bayar. Ada trade-off, termasuk kemungkinan pengaruh terhadap progres menuju penghapusan, jadi baca syaratnya dengan saksama.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - Tanyakan tentang opsi untuk menghentikan pemotongan upah atau offset pengembalian pajak, yang biasanya memerlukan penghubungan dengan agen penagihan atau Departemen Pendidikan.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## Cara membatasi kerusakan skor kredit sebelum tahun baru

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **Jangan biarkan pembayaran terlambat 90 hari.** Ambang pelaporan biasanya merupakan titik kritis. Menelepon pengelola pinjaman sebelum itu memberi Anda pilihan paling banyak.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **Atur autopay.** Banyak pengelola menawarkan pengurangan suku bunga kecil untuk pembayaran otomatis, dan ini mencegah keterlambatan tidak sengaja. Pastikan rekening bank memiliki dana yang cukup.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **Perhatikan perubahan tagihan.** Ketika paket berubah, jumlah pembayaran dan tanggal jatuh tempo Anda mungkin juga berubah. Baca setiap email dan pemberitahuan dari pengelola, dan periksa alamat surat serta informasi kontak Anda.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **Periksa laporan kredit Anda.** Anda dapat memperoleh laporan gratis dari ketiga biro di AnnualCreditReport.com. Pastikan status dan saldo pinjaman Anda akurat.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **Ajukan sanggahan atas kesalahan.** Jika pinjaman ditandai menunggak saat berada dalam penangguhan atau sedang diproses, dokumentasikan masalahnya dan ajukan sanggahan ke biro kredit dan pengelola pinjaman Anda. Simpan catatan tanggal, nama, dan nomor referensi panggilan.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **Jaga kesehatan kredit lainnya.** Jaga saldo kartu kredit tetap rendah dan bayar semua tagihan lain tepat waktu. Hindari membuka beberapa akun baru saat skor Anda sedang pulih.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **Waspadai pihak ketiga.** Perusahaan yang memungut biaya di muka untuk "penghapusan pinjaman mahasiswa" atau menjanjikan perbaikan kredit Anda adalah sumber penipuan yang sering terjadi. Sebagian besar yang mereka tawarkan umumnya bisa Anda lakukan secara gratis melalui pengelola pinjaman Anda atau StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## Berapa lama pemulihan memakan waktu?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: Keterlambatan pembayaran dapat tetap ada di laporan kredit hingga tujuh tahun, tetapi dampaknya memudar seiring waktu, terutama jika Anda membangun riwayat pembayaran tepat waktu setelahnya.

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: Membuat pinjaman kembali lancar atau menyelesaikan rehabilitasi dapat menghasilkan pemulihan skor secara bertahap.

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: Hasilnya bervariasi tergantung profil kredit Anda yang lain, jadi hindari mengharapkan angka tertentu.

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar periksa singkat akhir tahun

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - Pastikan paket pembayaran Anda dan tanggal perubahan yang diperlukan.

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - Pastikan pengelola pinjaman Anda memiliki nomor telepon, email, dan alamat Anda yang terbaru.

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - Pastikan jumlah pembayaran berikutnya dan tanggal jatuh tempo Anda.

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - Ambil laporan kredit Anda dan cari entri pinjaman mahasiswa yang tidak akurat.

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - Hubungi pengelola pinjaman Anda sebelum, bukan setelah, pembayaran terlewat.

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - Pertimbangkan efek pajak: Anda mungkin dapat mengurangkan hingga $2,500 bunga pinjaman mahasiswa jika memenuhi batas pendapatan, jadi simpan laporan bunga Anda (Form 1098-E).

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: Aturan untuk pinjaman mahasiswa federal sedang dalam masa transisi, dan biaya dari tidak bertindak semakin meningkat.

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: Peminjam yang memeriksa status paket mereka, tetap berhubungan dengan pengelola pinjaman, dan bertindak lebih awal atas pembayaran yang terlewat umumnya memiliki jauh lebih banyak pilihan dibanding mereka yang menunggu.

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: Sedikit waktu yang dihabiskan dalam beberapa minggu ke depan dapat melindungi baik anggaran maupun skor kredit Anda menjelang tahun baru.

segments.src: *Sources to check: StudentAid.gov, your loan servicer, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (consumerfinance.gov), and AnnualCreditReport.com.*
segments.tr: *Sumber untuk diperiksa: StudentAid.gov, pengelola pinjaman Anda, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (consumerfinance.gov), dan AnnualCreditReport.com.*

segments.tr: - **新たな借入上限。** 2026年半ば以降に初めて実行されるローンについては、Grad PLUSが廃止され、大学院およびParent PLUSローンに年間と生涯の上限が適用されます。主に今後の学生に関わる内容ですが、家族の計画にも影響します。

segments.tr: タイムラインや適格性、移行ルールは何度も変わってきているため、このまとめを含むいかなる要約も出発点として扱い、ご自身の選択肢の最新版を確認してください。

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## 今すぐ取れる選択肢

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **支払いが滞っていない場合**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - StudentAid.gov とサービサーのサイトにログインしてください。現在のプラン、月々の支払額、支払期日を確認します。

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - SAVEなど段階的に廃止されるプランを利用している場合は、いつまでに切り替えが必要か、どのプランの対象になるかを確認してください。

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - StudentAid.gov のローン・シミュレーターを使って、各プランでの支払額と総支払額を比較してください。

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **支払いは遅れているが、債務不履行ではない場合**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - すぐにサービサーに連絡してください。所得連動型プランについて尋ねてください。これにより支払額を下げられ、低所得世帯では大幅に下がることもあります。

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - 失業や経済的困窮など、適格な困難がある場合は、支払猶予（deferment）または猶予（forbearance）について尋ねてください。利息は発生し続ける場合があることに注意してください。

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - 滞納を解消できるか尋ねてください。一部のサービサーはアカウントを最新の状態に戻すことができ、それによって以降の遅延報告が止まります。

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **ローンが債務不履行の場合**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - **ローンのリハビリテーション（loan rehabilitation）**を検討してください。通常、合意された手頃な月次支払いを一定回数行うものです。完了すると信用履歴から債務不履行の状態が削除されることがありますが、それ以前の遅延支払いは残る場合があります。

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - 債務不履行から抜け出すもう一つの方法として、**ローンの統合（loan consolidation）**を Direct Consolidation Loan に行うことも検討してください。免除（forgiveness）への進捗に影響する可能性などのトレードオフがあるため、条件を注意深く読んでください。

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - 給与差し押さえや税金還付金の相殺を止める選択肢について尋ねてください。通常は回収代行業者または教育省への連絡が必要です。

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## 新年前に信用スコアの損害を抑える方法

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **支払いを90日遅れにしないこと。** 報告基準は通常の分岐点です。その前にサービサーへ連絡すれば、最も多くの選択肢が得られます。

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **自動払いを設定すること。** 多くのサービサーは自動払いに対して小さな金利引き下げを提供しており、うっかりした支払い漏れも防げます。引き落とし口座に十分な残高があるか確認してください。

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **請求の変更に注意すること。** プランが変わると、支払額や支払期日も変わる場合があります。サービサーからのすべてのメールや通知を読み、郵送先住所と連絡先情報も確認してください。

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **信用情報を確認すること。** AnnualCreditReport.com で3つの信用調査機関すべての報告書を無料で取得できます。ローンの状態と残高が正確かどうか確認してください。

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **誤りに異議を申し立てること。** 猶予中や処理中に延滞と表示された場合は、その問題を記録し、信用調査機関とサービサーの両方に異議申し立てを行ってください。日付、担当者名、通話の参照番号を保管してください。

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **他の信用を健全に保つこと。** クレジットカードの残高を低く抑え、他の請求もすべて期日どおりに支払ってください。スコアが回復する間は、新たな口座を複数開設しないようにしてください。

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **第三者には注意すること。** 「学生ローンの免除」を謳って前払い手数料を請求する業者や、信用を回復すると約束する業者は、詐欺の温床になりがちです。彼らが提供する内容の多くは、サービサーやStudentAid.gov を通じて通常は無料で行えます。

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## 回復にはどのくらいかかるか？

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: 遅延支払いは最長7年間、信用報告書に残ることがあります。ただし、その影響は時間とともに薄れていき、特にその後も期日どおりの支払い実績を積み上げた場合はなおさらです。

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: ローンを最新の状態に戻したり、リハビリテーションを完了させたりすることで、スコアは徐々に回復しうります。

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: 結果は信用プロファイルの他の要素によって異なるため、特定の数値を期待しないようにしてください。

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## 年末の簡単なチェックリスト

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - 返済プランと、必要な変更がある場合はその日付を確認する。

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - サービサーが最新の電話番号、メールアドレス、住所を把握しているか確認する。

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - 次回の支払額と支払期日を確認する。

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - 信用報告書を取り出し、学生ローンの不正確な記載がないか確認する。

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - 支払いが遅れた後ではなく、遅れる前にサービサーに連絡する。

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - 税務上の影響を検討する: 所得制限を満たせば、学生ローンの利息として最大2,500ドルまで控除できる場合があるため、利息明細（Form 1098-E）を保管してください。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: 連邦学生ローンのルールは移行期にあり、何もしないことのコストは上昇しています。

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: 返済プランの状態を確認し、サービサーとの連絡を保ち、支払い漏れには早めに対応する借り手は、一般的に、待っている借り手よりはるかに多くの選択肢を持っています。

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: 今後数週間に少し時間を使うことで、新年に向けて家計と信用スコアの両方を守ることができます。

segments.src: *Sources to check: StudentAid.gov, your loan servicer, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (consumerfinance.gov), and AnnualCreditReport.com.*
segments.tr: *確認すべき情報源: StudentAid.gov、ローンのサービサー、消費者金融保護局（consumerfinance.gov）、AnnualCreditReport.com。*

de.title: Studienkredite nach den neuen Regeln: Was sich bei der Rückzahlung ändert und welche Folgen Negativeinträge für die Bonität haben

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: Die Rückzahlung von Bundesstudienkrediten ist seit mehr als einem Jahr im Umbruch.

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: Ältere Tilgungspläne werden auslaufen gelassen, neue treten an ihre Stelle, und viele Kreditnehmer, die mit Zahlungen in Verzug geraten sind, stellen fest, dass sich dies in ihren Auskunftsberichten niederschlägt.

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie Bundesstudienkredite haben, ist jetzt ein guter Zeitpunkt, Ihren Status zu prüfen, bevor Fristen zum Jahresende und Abrechnungszyklen Probleme teurer machen.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur der allgemeinen Information und stellt keine finanzielle oder rechtliche Beratung dar.

segments.src: Program details change, so confirm current rules at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Programmdetails ändern sich, daher sollten Sie die aktuellen Regeln auf StudentAid.gov oder bei Ihrem Kreditservicer bestätigen.*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## Warum sich so viele Auskunftsberichte verändern

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: Zwei Entwicklungen erklären den größten Teil der jüngsten Probleme.

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: Meldung an die Auskunfteien wurde wieder aufgenommen.** Während der Zahlungspause aus der Pandemiezeit wurden Zahlungsrückstände bei Bundesdarlehen nicht gemeldet.

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: Die Rückzahlungen wurden Ende 2023 wieder aufgenommen, und eine einjährige „Anlaufphase“ schützte Kreditnehmer vor gemeldeten Zahlungsrückständen.

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: Nachdem dieser Schutz ausgelaufen war, tauchten verpasste Zahlungen wieder in den Auskunftsberichten auf.

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: Daten des Bundes sowie Untersuchungen der Federal Reserve Bank of New York zeigen, dass eine große Zahl von Kreditnehmern Score-Verluste hinnehmen musste, bei einigen fielen sie erheblich aus.

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: Inkassomaßnahmen wurden wieder aufgenommen.** Die Regierung hat 2025 die Eintreibung ausgefallener Bundesdarlehen wieder aufgenommen.

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: Mögliche Folgen sind die Verrechnung von Steuererstattungen und anderen Bundeszahlungen durch das Finanzministerium (Treasury Offset) sowie die administrative Lohnpfändung.

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: Ein Darlehen gilt in der Regel am Tag nach einer verpassten Zahlung als überfällig, wird nach 90 Tagen typischerweise als verspätet an die Auskunfteien gemeldet und geht bei den meisten Bundesdarlehen nach etwa 270 Tagen in Verzug (Default) über.

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: Die Zahlungshistorie ist in gängigen Scoring-Modellen der wichtigste einzelne Faktor.

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: Ein gemeldeter 90-Tage-Zahlungsrückstand kann den Score deutlich senken, besonders bei jemandem, der bisher eine makellose Historie hatte.

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## Was sich bei der Rückzahlung ändert

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: Das 2025 verabschiedete Bundesgesetz und laufende Rechtsstreitigkeiten zu älteren Tilgungsplänen haben das Angebot an Rückzahlungsmodellen neu geordnet.

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: Die wichtigsten Punkte:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **Der SAVE-Plan wird eingestellt.** Gerichtliche Entscheidungen haben Kreditnehmer in eine lange Stundung (Forbearance) geschickt, und das Programm wird schrittweise abgeschafft. Kreditnehmer, die eingeschrieben sind, müssen zu einem anderen Plan wechseln. Nach dem Wechsel können Zinsen anfallen und Zahlungen fällig werden.

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **Ein neuer Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** soll Kreditnehmern ab dem 1. Juli 2026 zur Verfügung stehen. Er bemisst die Zahlungen als Prozentsatz des Einkommens mit einer Mindestzahlung und sieht nach einer langen Rückzahlungsdauer einen Schuldenerlass vor.

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **Andere einkommensabhängige Optionen werden weniger.** Pläne wie PAYE und ICR sollen in den kommenden Jahren für neue Einschreibungen geschlossen werden; Kreditnehmer werden voraussichtlich generell zwischen einem Standardplan und RAP wählen müssen. Der einkommensabhängige Plan IBR bleibt für viele eine Option.

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **Neue Kreditobergrenzen.** Für Darlehen, die nach Mitte 2026 erstmals ausgezahlt werden, wurde Grad PLUS abgeschafft, und für Graduierten- sowie Parent-PLUS-Darlehen gelten jährliche und lebenslange Höchstbeträge. Das betrifft vor allem künftige Studierende, wirkt sich aber auf die Familienplanung aus.

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: Zeitpläne, Anspruchsvoraussetzungen und Übergangsregeln haben sich bereits mehrfach geändert. Betrachten Sie daher jede Zusammenfassung, auch diese, als Ausgangspunkt und prüfen Sie die aktuelle Fassung Ihrer Optionen.

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## Ihre Möglichkeiten im Moment

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **Wenn Sie bei den Zahlungen auf dem neuesten Stand sind**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - Melden Sie sich bei StudentAid.gov und auf der Website Ihres Servicers an. Prüfen Sie, in welchem Plan Sie sind, wie hoch Ihre monatliche Rate ist und wann sie fällig ist.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - Wenn Sie im SAVE-Plan oder einem anderen auslaufenden Plan sind, finden Sie heraus, wann Sie wechseln müssen und welche Pläne Ihnen offenstehen.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - Nutzen Sie den Loan Simulator auf StudentAid.gov, um die Zahlungsbeträge und Gesamtkosten der einzelnen Pläne zu vergleichen.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **Wenn Sie im Rückstand, aber noch nicht in Verzug sind**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - Kontaktieren Sie Ihren Servicer umgehend. Fragen Sie nach einem einkommensabhängigen Plan, der die Rate senken kann, bei Haushalten mit niedrigerem Einkommen manchmal deutlich.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - Fragen Sie nach Zahlungsaufschub (Deferment) oder Stundung (Forbearance), wenn Sie einen anerkannten Härtefall haben, etwa Arbeitslosigkeit oder wirtschaftliche Not. Beachten Sie, dass dennoch Zinsen anfallen können.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - Fragen Sie, ob Sie das Konto wieder auf den aktuellen Stand bringen können. Manche Servicer können ein Konto aktualisieren, wodurch weitere Verzugsmeldungen gestoppt werden.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **Wenn Ihr Darlehen in Verzug ist**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - Prüfen Sie die **Sanierung des Darlehens (Loan Rehabilitation)**, die in der Regel aus einer Reihe vereinbarter, erschwinglicher monatlicher Zahlungen besteht. Wird sie erfolgreich abgeschlossen, kann der Verzugsstatus aus Ihrer Kredithistorie entfernt werden, wobei frühere Zahlungsverzüge eventuell bestehen bleiben.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - Erwägen Sie die **Konsolidierung des Darlehens** in ein Direct Consolidation Loan als weiteren Weg aus dem Verzug. Sie hat Nachteile, unter anderem mögliche Auswirkungen auf den Fortschritt Richtung Erlass, lesen Sie die Bedingungen daher genau.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - Erkundigen Sie sich nach Möglichkeiten, Lohnpfändung oder die Verrechnung von Steuererstattungen zu stoppen. Dafür müssen Sie in der Regel die Inkassostelle oder das Bildungsministerium kontaktieren.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## Wie Sie den Bonitätsschaden vor dem Jahreswechsel begrenzen

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **Lassen Sie keine Zahlung 90 Tage überfällig werden.** Die Meldeschwellen sind meist die kritische Grenze. Ein Anruf bei Ihrem Servicer vorher eröffnet die meisten Möglichkeiten.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **Richten Sie Daueraufträge ein.** Viele Servicer gewähren einen kleinen Zinsnachlass für automatische Zahlungen, und so vermeiden Sie versehentliche Versäumnisse. Achten Sie darauf, dass das Bankkonto ausreichend gedeckt ist.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **Achten Sie auf Änderungen bei der Abrechnung.** Wenn sich der Plan ändert, können sich auch Zahlungsbetrag und Fälligkeitstermin ändern. Lesen Sie jede E-Mail und jeden Hinweis des Servicers und prüfen Sie Ihre Postanschrift und Kontaktdaten.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **Prüfen Sie Ihre Auskunftsberichte.** Kostenlose Berichte von allen drei Auskunfteien erhalten Sie über AnnualCreditReport.com. Kontrollieren Sie, ob Status und Saldo Ihrer Darlehen korrekt sind.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **Fechten Sie Fehler an.** Wird ein Darlehen als überfällig geführt, obwohl es gestundet war oder gerade bearbeitet wurde, dokumentieren Sie das Problem und reichen Sie einen Widerspruch bei der Auskunftei und Ihrem Servicer ein. Bewahren Sie Datumsangaben, Namen und Referenznummern von Telefonaten auf.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **Halten Sie andere Kredite in gutem Zustand.** Halten Sie Kreditkartensalden niedrig und bezahlen Sie alle anderen Rechnungen pünktlich. Eröffnen Sie während der Erholung Ihres Scores nicht mehrere neue Konten.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **Seien Sie vorsichtig bei Drittanbietern.** Firmen, die vorab Gebühren für „Studienkredit-Erlass“ verlangen oder versprechen, Ihre Bonität zu reparieren, sind eine häufige Betrugsquelle. Alles, was sie anbieten, können Sie in der Regel kostenlos über Ihren Servicer oder StudentAid.gov erledigen.

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## Wie lange dauert die Erholung?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: Verspätete Zahlungen können bis zu sieben Jahre im Auskunftsbericht stehen, ihre Auswirkung nimmt aber mit der Zeit ab, besonders wenn danach eine Reihe pünktlicher Zahlungen folgt.

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie ein Darlehen wieder auf den aktuellen Stand bringen oder die Sanierung abschließen, kann sich der Score schrittweise erholen.

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis hängt vom übrigen Kreditprofil ab, daher sollten Sie keine bestimmte Zahl erwarten.

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## Kurze Checkliste zum Jahresende

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - Bestätigen Sie Ihren Rückzahlungsplan und das Datum eines etwaigen Wechsels.

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - Prüfen Sie, ob Ihr Servicer Ihre aktuelle Telefonnummer, E-Mail-Adresse und Anschrift hat.

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - Bestätigen Sie Ihren nächsten Zahlungsbetrag und das Fälligkeitsdatum.

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - Rufen Sie Ihre Auskunftsberichte ab und suchen Sie nach fehlerhaften Einträgen zu Studienkrediten.

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - Kontaktieren Sie Ihren Servicer, bevor eine Zahlung versäumt wird, nicht erst danach.

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - Denken Sie an steuerliche Effekte: Sie können bis zu 2.500 US-Dollar Studienkreditzinsen absetzen, wenn Sie die Einkommensgrenzen einhalten. Bewahren Sie daher Ihre Zinsbescheinigungen (Formular 1098-E) auf.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: Die Regeln für Bundesstudienkredite befinden sich im Umbruch, und die Kosten des Abwartens steigen.

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: Kreditnehmer, die ihren Planstatus prüfen, mit ihrem Servicer in Kontakt bleiben und bei verpassten Zahlungen früh handeln, haben in der Regel weit mehr Möglichkeiten als diejenigen, die abwarten.

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: Ein wenig Zeit in den nächsten Wochen kann Ihr Budget und Ihren Kredit-Score für das neue Jahr schützen.

vi.title: Vay sinh viên theo quy định mới: Thay đổi trong trả nợ và tác động đến điểm tín dụng đối với người vay

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment has been in flux for more than a year.
segments.tr: Việc trả nợ khoản vay sinh viên liên bang đã có nhiều biến động trong hơn một năm qua.

segments.src: Older plans are being wound down, new ones are taking their place, and many borrowers who fell behind are finding the damage on their credit reports.
segments.tr: Các gói trả nợ cũ đang dần bị chấm dứt, các gói mới đang thay thế, và nhiều người vay đã trễ hạn đang thấy thiệt hại xuất hiện trên báo cáo tín dụng của họ.

segments.src: If you hold federal student loans, now is a good time to check your status, before year-end deadlines and billing cycles make any problems more expensive.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn đang có khoản vay sinh viên liên bang, bây giờ là thời điểm tốt để kiểm tra tình trạng của mình, trước khi các hạn chót cuối năm và chu kỳ thanh toán khiến mọi vấn đề trở nên tốn kém hơn.

segments.tr: *Bài viết này chỉ mang tính thông tin chung, không phải là tư vấn tài chính hay pháp lý.

segments.tr: Chi tiết chương trình thay đổi thường xuyên, vì vậy hãy xác nhận các quy định hiện hành tại StudentAid.gov hoặc với đơn vị quản lý khoản vay của bạn.*

segments.src: ## Why so many credit reports are changing
segments.tr: ## Vì sao nhiều báo cáo tín dụng đang thay đổi

segments.src: Two developments explain most of the recent trouble.
segments.tr: Hai diễn biến giải thích phần lớn các vấn đề gần đây.

segments.src: Reporting to credit bureaus resumed.** During the pandemic-era payment pause, delinquencies on federal loans were not reported.
segments.tr: Việc báo cáo cho các cơ quan tín dụng đã được nối lại.** Trong giai đoạn tạm hoãn thanh toán thời đại dịch, các khoản trễ hạn đối với khoản vay liên bang không được báo cáo.

segments.src: Payments restarted in late 2023, and a one-year "on-ramp" period shielded borrowers from reported delinquencies.
segments.tr: Việc thanh toán được khôi phục vào cuối năm 2023, và giai đoạn “chuyển tiếp” một năm đã bảo vệ người vay khỏi các khoản trễ hạn bị báo cáo.

segments.src: Once that protection ended, missed payments began to appear on credit reports again.
segments.tr: Khi thời gian bảo vệ đó kết thúc, các khoản thanh toán bị bỏ lỡ bắt đầu xuất hiện trở lại trên báo cáo tín dụng.

segments.src: Federal data and research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York have shown that a large number of borrowers saw their scores fall, and that some saw large drops.
segments.tr: Dữ liệu liên bang và nghiên cứu từ Ngân hàng Dự trữ Liên bang New York cho thấy một số lượng lớn người vay bị giảm điểm, và một số người bị giảm mạnh.

segments.src: Collections activity restarted.** The government resumed collection on defaulted federal loans in 2025.
segments.tr: Hoạt động thu hồi nợ đã được tiếp tục.** Chính phủ đã tiếp tục thu hồi các khoản vay liên bang đã vỡ nợ vào năm 2025.

segments.src: Possible consequences include Treasury offset of tax refunds and other federal payments, and administrative wage garnishment.
segments.tr: Các hệ quả có thể bao gồm việc Kho bạc khấu trừ tiền hoàn thuế và các khoản thanh toán liên bang khác, cũng như việc khấu trừ tiền lương hành chính.

segments.src: A loan generally becomes delinquent the day after a missed payment, is typically reported as late to the bureaus after 90 days, and enters default after about 270 days for most federal loans.
segments.tr: Một khoản vay thường bị coi là quá hạn vào ngày sau khi bỏ lỡ một kỳ thanh toán, thường được báo cáo là trễ hạn cho các cơ quan tín dụng sau 90 ngày, và rơi vào tình trạng vỡ nợ sau khoảng 270 ngày đối với hầu hết các khoản vay liên bang.

segments.src: Payment history is the largest single factor in common scoring models.
segments.tr: Lịch sử thanh toán là yếu tố lớn nhất đơn lẻ trong các mô hình chấm điểm phổ biến.

segments.src: A reported 90-day delinquency can lower a score significantly, especially for someone who previously had a clean record.
segments.tr: Một khoản trễ hạn 90 ngày được báo cáo có thể làm giảm điểm đáng kể, đặc biệt đối với người trước đó có hồ sơ sạch.

segments.src: ## What is changing in repayment
segments.tr: ## Những thay đổi trong trả nợ

segments.src: Federal legislation passed in 2025 and ongoing litigation over older plans have reshaped the repayment menu.
segments.tr: Luật liên bang được thông qua năm 2025 và các vụ kiện đang diễn ra đối với các gói cũ đã định hình lại danh mục trả nợ.

segments.src: The main points to know:
segments.tr: Những điểm chính cần biết:

segments.src: - **The SAVE plan is ending.** Court actions left borrowers in a long forbearance, and the program is being phased out. Borrowers who were enrolled need to move to another plan. Interest may accrue and payments will be due once you are moved.
segments.tr: - **Gói SAVE đang chấm dứt.** Các hành động pháp lý khiến người vay rơi vào thời gian tạm hoãn kéo dài, và chương trình đang được loại bỏ dần. Những người vay đã đăng ký cần chuyển sang gói khác. Lãi có thể phát sinh và các khoản thanh toán sẽ đến hạn khi bạn được chuyển.

segments.src: - **A new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)** is scheduled to be available to borrowers beginning July 1, 2026. It sets payments as a percentage of income, with a minimum payment, and offers loan forgiveness after a long repayment period.
segments.tr: - **Gói Hỗ trợ Trả nợ mới (RAP)** dự kiến có hiệu lực đối với người vay bắt đầu từ ngày 1 tháng 7 năm 2026. Gói này đặt mức thanh toán theo tỷ lệ phần trăm thu nhập, có mức thanh toán tối thiểu, và cung cấp khoản xóa nợ sau một thời gian trả nợ dài.

segments.src: - **Other income-driven options are narrowing.** Plans such as PAYE and ICR are scheduled to close to new enrollment in the coming years, and borrowers are generally expected to choose between a standard plan and RAP. Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains an option for many.
segments.tr: - **Các lựa chọn trả nợ theo thu nhập khác đang thu hẹp.** Các gói như PAYE và ICR dự kiến sẽ đóng việc đăng ký mới trong những năm tới, và người vay thường được kỳ vọng sẽ lựa chọn giữa gói tiêu chuẩn và RAP. Trả nợ theo thu nhập (IBR) vẫn là một lựa chọn cho nhiều người.

segments.src: - **New borrowing limits.** For loans first disbursed after mid-2026, Grad PLUS has been eliminated and annual and lifetime caps apply to graduate and Parent PLUS loans. This matters mostly to future students, but it affects family planning.
segments.tr: - **Giới hạn vay mới.** Đối với các khoản vay được giải ngân lần đầu sau giữa năm 2026, Grad PLUS đã bị bãi bỏ và áp dụng giới hạn hằng năm và trọn đời đối với các khoản vay PLUS dành cho sinh viên sau đại học và phụ huynh. Điều này chủ yếu liên quan đến sinh viên tương lai, nhưng cũng ảnh hưởng đến kế hoạch tài chính gia đình.

segments.src: Timelines, eligibility and transition rules have shifted several times, so treat any summary, including this one, as a starting point and verify the current version of your options.
segments.tr: Thời hạn, điều kiện đủ điều kiện và quy tắc chuyển đổi đã thay đổi nhiều lần, vì vậy hãy xem bất kỳ bản tóm tắt nào, kể cả bản này, như điểm khởi đầu và xác minh phiên bản hiện tại của các lựa chọn của bạn.

segments.src: ## Your options right now
segments.tr: ## Các lựa chọn của bạn ngay bây giờ

segments.src: **If you are current on payments**
segments.tr: **Nếu bạn đang thanh toán đúng hạn**

segments.src: - Log in to StudentAid.gov and your servicer's site. Confirm which plan you are on, your monthly amount, and your due date.
segments.tr: - Đăng nhập vào StudentAid.gov và trang web của đơn vị quản lý khoản vay. Xác nhận bạn đang ở gói nào, số tiền hàng tháng và ngày đến hạn.

segments.src: - If you are on SAVE or another plan being phased out, find out when you must switch and which plans you qualify for.
segments.tr: - Nếu bạn đang ở gói SAVE hoặc gói khác đang bị loại bỏ, hãy tìm hiểu khi nào bạn phải chuyển và bạn đủ điều kiện cho những gói nào.

segments.src: - Use the Loan Simulator on StudentAid.gov to compare payment amounts and total cost under each plan.
segments.tr: - Sử dụng Công cụ Mô phỏng Khoản vay trên StudentAid.gov để so sánh số tiền thanh toán và tổng chi phí theo từng gói.

segments.src: **If you are behind but not in default**
segments.tr: **Nếu bạn đang trễ hạn nhưng chưa vỡ nợ**

segments.src: - Contact your servicer right away. Ask about an income-driven plan, which can lower the payment, sometimes sharply for lower-income households.
segments.tr: - Liên hệ ngay với đơn vị quản lý khoản vay. Hỏi về gói trả nợ theo thu nhập, có thể giảm số tiền thanh toán, đôi khi giảm đáng kể đối với hộ gia đình thu nhập thấp.

segments.src: - Ask about deferment or forbearance if you have a qualifying hardship, such as unemployment or economic hardship. Note that interest may still accrue.
segments.tr: - Hỏi về hoãn nợ hoặc tạm ngừng thanh toán nếu bạn có hoàn cảnh khó khăn đủ điều kiện, chẳng hạn như thất nghiệp hoặc khó khăn kinh tế. Lưu ý rằng lãi vẫn có thể phát sinh.

segments.src: - Ask about getting current. Some servicers can bring an account up to date, which stops further late reports.
segments.tr: - Hỏi về việc cập nhật lại tình trạng thanh toán. Một số đơn vị quản lý có thể đưa tài khoản trở lại đúng hạn, giúp ngăn các báo cáo trễ hạn tiếp theo.

segments.src: **If your loan is in default**
segments.tr: **Nếu khoản vay của bạn đã vỡ nợ**

segments.src: - Look into **loan rehabilitation**, which typically involves a series of agreed, affordable monthly payments. Successfully completing it can remove the default status from your credit history, although earlier late payments may remain.
segments.tr: - Tìm hiểu về **phục hồi khoản vay**, thường bao gồm một chuỗi các khoản thanh toán hằng tháng đã thỏa thuận và phù hợp khả năng chi trả. Hoàn thành thành công có thể xóa trạng thái vỡ nợ khỏi lịch sử tín dụng, mặc dù các khoản trễ hạn trước đó có thể vẫn còn.

segments.src: - Consider **loan consolidation** into a Direct Consolidation Loan as another route out of default. It has trade-offs, including a possible effect on progress toward forgiveness, so read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - Cân nhắc **hợp nhất khoản vay** thành Khoản vay Hợp nhất Trực tiếp như một con đường khác để thoát khỏi tình trạng vỡ nợ. Phương án này có những đánh đổi, bao gồm khả năng ảnh hưởng đến tiến trình hướng tới xóa nợ, vì vậy hãy đọc kỹ các điều khoản.

segments.src: - Ask about options to stop wage garnishment or tax refund offset, which usually require contacting the collection agency or the Department of Education.
segments.tr: - Hỏi về các lựa chọn để dừng khấu trừ tiền lương hoặc khấu trừ tiền hoàn thuế, thường cần liên hệ với đơn vị thu hồi nợ hoặc Bộ Giáo dục.

segments.src: ## How to limit the credit score damage before the new year
segments.tr: ## Cách hạn chế thiệt hại điểm tín dụng trước năm mới

segments.src: 1. **Do not let a payment hit 90 days late.** Reporting thresholds are usually the cliff. A call to your servicer before then gives you the most options.
segments.tr: 1. **Đừng để khoản thanh toán trễ 90 ngày.** Các ngưỡng báo cáo thường là điểm “vách đá”. Gọi cho đơn vị quản lý trước thời điểm đó sẽ mang lại nhiều lựa chọn nhất.

segments.src: 2. **Set up autopay.** Many servicers offer a small interest-rate reduction for automatic payments, and it prevents accidental misses. Make sure the bank account has enough funds.
segments.tr: 2. **Thiết lập thanh toán tự động.** Nhiều đơn vị quản lý cung cấp giảm lãi suất nhỏ cho thanh toán tự động, và điều này giúp tránh bỏ lỡ do sơ suất. Đảm bảo tài khoản ngân hàng có đủ tiền.

segments.src: 3. **Watch for billing changes.** When a plan changes, your payment amount and due date may too. Read every servicer email and notice, and check your mailing address and contact information.
segments.tr: 3. **Theo dõi các thay đổi về hóa đơn.** Khi gói thay đổi, số tiền thanh toán và ngày đến hạn cũng có thể thay đổi. Đọc kỹ mọi email và thông báo từ đơn vị quản lý, đồng thời kiểm tra địa chỉ nhận thư và thông tin liên hệ của bạn.

segments.src: 4. **Check your credit reports.** You can get free reports from all three bureaus at AnnualCreditReport.com. Verify that your loan statuses and balances are accurate.
segments.tr: 4. **Kiểm tra báo cáo tín dụng.** Bạn có thể nhận báo cáo miễn phí từ cả ba cơ quan tín dụng tại AnnualCreditReport.com. Xác minh rằng trạng thái và số dư khoản vay của bạn là chính xác.

segments.src: 5. **Dispute errors.** If a loan is marked delinquent while it was in forbearance or being processed, document the issue and file a dispute with the bureau and your servicer. Keep records of dates, names and call reference numbers.
segments.tr: 5. **Khiếu nại lỗi.** Nếu một khoản vay bị đánh dấu quá hạn trong khi đang tạm hoãn hoặc đang được xử lý, hãy ghi lại vấn đề và gửi khiếu nại đến cơ quan tín dụng và đơn vị quản lý. Lưu giữ hồ sơ về ngày tháng, tên và số tham chiếu cuộc gọi.

segments.src: 6. **Keep other credit healthy.** Keep credit card balances low and pay all other bills on time. Avoid opening several new accounts while your score is recovering.
segments.tr: 6. **Duy trì các khoản tín dụng khác ổn định.** Giữ số dư thẻ tín dụng ở mức thấp và thanh toán đúng hạn mọi hóa đơn khác. Tránh mở nhiều tài khoản mới trong khi điểm của bạn đang phục hồi.

segments.src: 7. **Be careful with third parties.** Companies that charge upfront fees for "student loan forgiveness" or promise to fix your credit are a frequent source of scams. Everything they offer, you can generally do for free through your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: 7. **Cẩn thận với bên thứ ba.** Các công ty thu phí trả trước cho “xóa nợ sinh viên” hoặc hứa sửa tín dụng của bạn là nguồn lừa đảo thường gặp. Hầu hết những gì họ cung cấp, bạn thường có thể tự làm miễn phí thông qua đơn vị quản lý hoặc StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: ## How long does recovery take?
segments.tr: ## Phục hồi mất bao lâu?

segments.src: Late payments can stay on a credit report for up to seven years, but their impact fades over time, especially if you build a record of on-time payments afterward.
segments.tr: Các khoản thanh toán trễ có thể nằm trên báo cáo tín dụng tới bảy năm, nhưng tác động của chúng giảm dần theo thời gian, đặc biệt nếu bạn xây dựng lịch sử thanh toán đúng hạn sau đó.

segments.src: Bringing a loan current or completing rehabilitation can lead to a gradual score recovery.
segments.tr: Đưa khoản vay về trạng thái đúng hạn hoặc hoàn thành phục hồi có thể dẫn đến việc điểm số phục hồi dần dần.

segments.src: Results vary with the rest of your credit profile, so avoid expecting a specific number.
segments.tr: Kết quả phụ thuộc vào phần còn lại của hồ sơ tín dụng của bạn, vì vậy đừng kỳ vọng một con số cụ thể.

segments.src: ## A short year-end checklist
segments.tr: ## Danh sách kiểm tra ngắn cuối năm

segments.src: - Confirm your repayment plan and the date of any required change.
segments.tr: - Xác nhận gói trả nợ và ngày của bất kỳ thay đổi bắt buộc nào.

segments.src: - Verify your servicer has your current phone, email and address.
segments.tr: - Xác minh đơn vị quản lý có số điện thoại, email và địa chỉ hiện tại của bạn.

segments.src: - Confirm your next payment amount and due date.
segments.tr: - Xác nhận số tiền thanh toán tiếp theo và ngày đến hạn.

segments.src: - Pull your credit reports and look for inaccurate student loan entries.
segments.tr: - Lấy báo cáo tín dụng và tìm các mục khoản vay sinh viên không chính xác.

segments.src: - Contact your servicer before, not after, a payment is missed.
segments.tr: - Liên hệ đơn vị quản lý trước khi bỏ lỡ thanh toán, không phải sau.

segments.src: - Consider tax effects: you may be able to deduct up to $2,500 of student loan interest if you meet income limits, so keep your interest statements (Form 1098-E).
segments.tr: - Cân nhắc ảnh hưởng thuế: bạn có thể được khấu trừ tối đa 2.500 đô la tiền lãi khoản vay sinh viên nếu đáp ứng giới hạn thu nhập, vì vậy hãy giữ các bảng sao kê lãi (Mẫu 1098-E).

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kết luận

segments.src: The rules for federal student loans are in transition, and the cost of inaction is rising.
segments.tr: Các quy định về khoản vay sinh viên liên bang đang trong giai đoạn chuyển đổi, và chi phí của việc không hành động đang tăng lên.

segments.src: Borrowers who check their plan status, stay in touch with their servicer and act early on any missed payment generally have far more options than those who wait.
segments.tr: Những người vay kiểm tra tình trạng gói của mình, giữ liên lạc với đơn vị quản lý và hành động sớm khi bỏ lỡ thanh toán thường có nhiều lựa chọn hơn hẳn so với những người chờ đợi.

segments.src: A little time spent in the next few weeks can protect both your budget and your credit score going into the new year.
segments.tr: Dành một chút thời gian trong vài tuần tới có thể bảo vệ cả ngân sách và điểm tín dụng của bạn khi bước sang năm mới.
